verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v2: ʾinna r-rubūʿa bishāratī waʾamānatī warabīʿu qalbī wahyā khayru shayāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v3: wad-damʿu ʾidh baʿudat rubūʿu rubūʿinā jāri wajāriḥu manḥarī bisihāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v4: mah ʿādhilī law ḥuzta ʿilmā lam talum hal ʿadhlu mithlī lam yakun biḥarāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v5: malaʾa l-fuʾāda quḍātu shawqī wal-hawā ʾalamā wawajdā yā laṭūla huyāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v6: yā ghādiyā yaʿlū s-sināda faballighan salʿā wasal ʿan jīratī bisalāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v7: fārbaʿ ʿalā majnūni laylā ʾinna lī dāʾa dawiyyā mā ʾaballa saqāmī
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v8: wāqraʾa salāmā ṭayyibā tufshīhi min ḥibbi ʾilā nāsi hudīta himāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v9: bayyin lahum tabyīna barri ṣādiqi ʾannī bihim ḥilfu l-jawā wagharāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v10: yā rubba layli bittu sāmira ʾanqadi mutajāwibā mutasājilāti ḥamāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v11: ʾarʿā l-kawākiba fī ṣ-ṣarīmi kaʾannahā shuddat biʾahdābī ṣamāmi ṣamāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v12: ʿutumu ẓirāfu kummalu lakinnahum lam yaʿrifū n-naqarā biwaqti hishāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v13: ʿadlu kirāmu maʿdinā lakinnahum nālū ladā t-taqsīmi khayra sihāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v14: ṭ-ṭayyibūna maʿāqidā lakinnahum min jūdihim qaṭarātu ghaythi rukāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v15: lā ʿayba fīhim ghayra ʾanna jumūʿahum summu l-ʿudāti suʿūdu kulli ʾidāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v16: ʿusulu ṣufātu muʿtafūna nawālahum yansawna ʾahlahumu liṭībi muqāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v17: wahumu n-nujūmu limuqtadi bisamāʾihim badru d-dujā minhu njilāʾu ẓalāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v18: shamsu l-hudā minhu nahāru wujūdinā ʾakrim bibadri ʾawwali wakhitāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v19: mudh kāna ʾaṭlaʿa qad ʾatā fawzu lanā wal-kufru fī kufri badā wasidāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v20: ʾawqā waʾawfā quṭbunā waʾimāmunā wazarā waʿahdā min jamīʿi ʾanāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v21: wabikhaylihi wabikhayrihi jalaba l-warā waliman ʾajābū naylu khayri marāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v22: huwa sirrunā huwa nūrunā huwa majdunā wahwa l-mushaffaʿu ʿinda yawmi khiṣāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v23: wasaʿādatu waʾamānatu wamakānatu wamafāzatu ghunmu wakhayru ʾimāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v24: waṣabīḥu ṣubḥi fakhruhu mutaʾaththilu min ʾāli bayti muṣṭafayna kirāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v25: waḍalīʿu fammi thaghruhu kaburūqi ʾaw ḥabbi l-ghamāmi ladā btidāʾi bisāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v26: ʾibrīqu sāmi ʿunquhu qul ʿarquhu kalāʾāliʾi bal fawqahā bimaqāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v27: wamurajjalu sabṭu l-ʿiẓāmi muṭayyibu wakaʾanna fī l-ʿirnīni waṣfa shamāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v28: fī kaffihi khayru sh-shifāʾi waraḥmahu ʾishbāʿu jūʿi wānhilāku liʾāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v30: ʾaṣḥābuhu qad yartawūna jamīʿuhum watawaḍḍaʾū min māʾi fayḍi banāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v31: waḥaṣātuhā qad sabbaḥat tasbīḥa man ḥāza l-ḥaṣāta fafāra māʾu dhimāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v32: wabirīqihi fayḍu l-qalīli shifāʾu dā ʾi sal ʿaliyyā kayfa rīqu ʾidāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v33: wabirīqihi milḥu ʾujāju salsalu ʾakrim bihādī l-muhtadīna ḥumāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v34: sal ʿutbaha rīqa n-nabiyyī l-muṣṭafā maṣṣu llisāni bihi ntifāʾu ʾuwāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v36: yā rubba man qad salla min ʿarqi n-nabī ʾakrim bihi ṭībā biṭībi ʾuzāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v37: ṭību wamāʾu qad tasalsala rīquhu ʿasalu madhāqatuhu dawāʾu ʿuqāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v38: wakhulūfu ʾafwāhi liman bāyaʿnahu khamsā nafāhu bimaḍghihi lil-ḥāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v39: wabirijlihi taskīnu ṣakhri qul lahā ʾatharu matā tamshī fuwayqa ʾikāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v40: bitakaffuʾi yamshī l-huwaynā lā lahā fī s-sahli min ʾathari walā bishiyāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v41: tawṣīfuhu biz-zuhdi ʿaynu jahālati hal kāna ʾiqbālu likhayri ʾimāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v42: badru sarā laylā yunājī rabbahu walahu l-ʾimāmatu farra ʿinda salāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v43: ʾakrim biman jibrīlu min khuddāmihi mīkālu ʾisrāfīlu shamsu ʿayāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v44: huwa ḥāmidu huwa ʾaḥmadu wamuḥammadu wahuwa l-munājā ḥāza ṭība kalāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v45: wamubashsharu hādi bashīru murtaḍā wahuwa l-ʾimāmu limasjidi waṣurāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v46: wamukhayyaru yakhtāru nayla ʿubūdati lihawāni dāri hiyyā sharru muqāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v47: walahu ʾimāmu man tanahaja nahjahu yasluk ʾimāmā kāna khayra ʾimāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v48: man qāla mithlu l-badri yā jahlā lahu ʾaw lam yakun min nūri ṭabbi ʾathāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v49: badru tamannā l-ʾanbiyāʾu maqāmahu waliqāʾahu ʾidh fāta naylu marāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v50: faṣlu yakūnu liʾaṣlihi ḥamdu ʾidhā mā rāʾa sāqa l-ʿarshi khayra ʾasāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v51: shamsu ḍ-ḍuḥā ʾamalat ʿushayra ḍiyāʾihi ʾidh fātahā ʾitamarat liʾamri l-māmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v52: walahā ḥayāʾu fī burūzi ẓilālihā min nūrihi kaburūzi ẓilli ghamāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v53: wānshaqqa badru ʾidh tamannā khāʾibā liyakūna min khuddāmi khayri kirāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v54: laythu bihi ṣāra lluyūthu kaqirdati wallusnu qad ṣārū bihi kafidāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v55: ʾinna n-naʿāmata fī ttibāʿi naʿāmati tabiʿat naʿāmatuhu murīda salāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v56: man ʿāfa ʾīmānā fafī ʾaymānihim mā yadfaʿūna ʿināda ghayri ʾidāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v57: fiʾahu riḍā qad bāyaʿūhu lirabbihim wariḍāhumu mawlāhumu biʾimāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v58: qawmu ʾunūfu ʾānifūna lighayri mā yurḍī ʾilahā ghāfirā bidawāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v59: ʾin kunta bāki fābki ʾaṣḥāba n-nabī mā dumta bāqi sirta khayra niẓāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v60: wabiṣāḥibi l-khātāmi khātimi l-nbiyā fāmnun ʿalaynā rabbi ḥusna khitāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v61: yā muntahī l-ʾāmāli yā rabba l-warā ʾinnī ʾataytuka lābisā biʾathāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v62: thumma ṣ-ṣalatu maʿa s-salāmi tabārayā ʾamada d-duhūri ʿalā shafīʿi l-ʾanāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v63: wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi l-kirāmi jamīʿihim mā lāḥa barqu ʾaw budūru ẓalāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v1: ʾabadā burūqu taḥta junḥi ẓalāmi ʾam wajhu mayyata ʾam rubūʿu shamāmi?
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v29: fī kaffihi rīḥu tafūḥu watazdarī rīḥa l-khuzāmā ʾaw ṣafiyyā mudāmi
verses.abada-buruqun-tahta-junhi-zalami-c1-v35: ruḍaʿāʾuhu ruḍaʿā l-batūli birīqihi astaghnā biʿāshūrāʾa yā laʾimāmi
